question: For each network status, show the status and compute both the variance and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the security group binding order (PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) across networks that have at least one security binding, excluding shared networks (i.e., excluding networks that have an RBAC entry with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'). Do not return any rounded answers.

       VARIANCE(nsb.port_security_enabled) AS variance,
       STDDEV(nsb.port_security_enabled) AS stddev
FROM networks n
JOIN networksecuritybindings nsb ON nsb.network_id = n.id
WHERE n.id NOT IN (
    SELECT object_id FROM networkrbacs
    WHERE action = 'access_as_shared'
      AND target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
)
GROUP BY n.status
